" width="1254"/><div class="portrait-footnote">A creative portrait of how I work. <em>“You might call it pressure. I call it oxygen.”</em></div></div>
</section>
<section class="section" id="perspective"><div class="container"><div class="sectionhead"><div><div class="tag">The proposition</div><h2 class="sectiontitle">Operational leverage.</h2></div><span class="topnote">Discreet · Mobile · Accountable</span></div>
<div class="two"><p class="pull">"The principal makes the decision. My job is to make execution feel effortless."</p><div><p>I enjoy difficult assignments. Give me a moving target, a last-minute change or an unfamiliar situation, and I become more focused. I know how to lead people, work with specialists and take responsibility for the result.</p><p>My role is not to compete for the spotlight. It is to anticipate what the principal needs, reduce avoidable friction and create room for their most important decisions.</p><p>Close enough to understand the context. Independent enough to execute. Experienced enough to recognise when a decision requires specialist advice.</p></div></div></div></section>
<section class="section" id="experience"><div class="container"><div class="sectionhead"><div><div class="tag">Selected experience</div><h2 class="sectiontitle">Built, not just managed.</h2></div></div>
<div class="case-grid"><div class="case"><div class="number">2014—</div><strong>Sanglung Villas &amp; Suites</strong><p>Founded, developed and manage an approximately 20-key luxury resort in North Bali, operated to five-star service standards. Private-pool villas and suites, restaurant, bar and spa. Personalised butler arrangements on request. Built from bare land with full operational and financial responsibility and a core team of approximately 50.</p><p class="operation-example">An operational example: when dry-season village water supply is insufficient, I arrange supplemental tanker deliveries to maintain water reserves and keep the resort running.</p></div><div class="case"><div class="number">2 × 17</div><strong>Valencia boutique hotels</strong><p>Founded and operated ABCyou and Zalamera, two boutique city hotels with 17 rooms each. Property improvement, commercial operations, guest experience and multidisciplinary teams.</p></div><div class="case"><div class="number">6 villas</div><strong>Private villas · Aruba &amp; Bali</strong><p>Developed, fitted out and operated two villas in Aruba and four in Ubud, Bali. Managed design, contractors, Indonesian sourcing, international shipping, procurement, guest readiness and eventual exits.</p></div></div>
<div class="vip-highlight">
<div class="tag">High-profile guest operations</div>
<p>Personally hosted high-profile guests, including governors and members of parliament. Where individually requested and appropriately authorised, helped organise discreet private arrangements, helicopter transport and police escorts. These were bespoke guest arrangements, not standard resort services.</p>
</div>
<div class="production-head"><div class="tag">Beyond hospitality</div><h3>Production, people, pressure.</h3></div>
<div class="story-grid">
<article class="story">
<div class="story-meta">Film production · Spain · 2003</div>
<h4><em>The Bridge of San Luis Rey</em></h4>
<p>Provided production assistance, on-location logistics and personal transport during the 2003 filming of The Bridge of San Luis Rey, directed by Mary McGuckian. Personally supported director McGuckian, Kathy Bates, Geraldine Chaplin and costume designer Yvonne Blake. Blake, an Academy Award winner, also won the film’s 2005 Goya for Best Costume Design. The wider cast included Academy Award winners Robert De Niro and F. Murray Abraham, as well as Harvey Keitel; these names are cast context, not a claim of personal transport.</p>
<p class="story-secondary">Raised in a Dutch film and television family. My father was director René van Nie; my mother worked in production and later became a TV producer and director, as did my stepfather; my sister is actress Nada van Nie.</p>
</article>
<article class="story">
<div class="story-meta">Live events · Spain · 2003</div>
<h4>Unilever Leadership Event</h4>
<p>Worked in event-production logistics for a three-day Unilever leadership event in Almería, Spain, produced by Signum Niehe Events for around 1,000 participants. The programme combined international arrivals, hospitality and filmed Western-themed team-building activities.</p>
<p class="story-secondary">Signum Niehe Events received the Silver Gouden Giraffe for this event in 2003. This was an agency award, not an individual award.</p>
</article>
</div>
<p class="breadth">Earlier work across nightlife operations, publishing, film and live events, airline ticketing, IT and creative technology adds practical breadth. Full chronology remains in the executive CV.</p>
</div></section>
